name: Saito (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Saito city emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing two interlocking loops.
history: Municipal flag of Saito, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 23 October 1968; the emblem dates from 1 April 1961.

features.role: Saito city emblem — a winged ring enclosing two interlocking loops
